comments.text: The 'misjudge what's urgent' caveat is the real story, not the waitlist. Muse, Dots, and now Duet all ship with the same disclaimer — triage judgment, not task execution, is agentic work's actual unsolved problem. How's Duet's escalation threshold different from Dots'?

Carrying over memory, skills, and connected apps instead of a fresh onboarding flow is the detail knowledge workers will actually feel — most agent launches still make you re-teach context every session. Does that carry across devices, or just within one session?
